answer: Cheap clones fail a personal puzzle river no other key can reuse. A joiner locks 2,200 idle POA for 18 epochs. Each epoch that key gets one signed puzzle and must post a correct result before a 20-minute horizon; two out-of-cluster reviewers attest freshness. A late, copied, or failed ticket slashes 550 POA and leaves a hollow in the bond; three failures exile the key 16 epochs. One honest lock is 2,200 POA; 1,000 fakes need 2.2 million POA plus 2,000 foreign reviewers, above a ~180 POA reward. Hired reviewers are the risk; redraw them each epoch and slash both keys sharing a funding source.
